title: Planet Tweaks V3.2.2 NOVA TITAN - Esports Mouse Queue Lock, Zero-Crash Key Remapper, Mic Isolation & ExitLag Auto-Ping
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.2.2 NOVA TITAN: (1) Esports Mouse Data Queue Lock: User-selectable buffer (8, 20, 32, 64) locked by Tweak Watchdog against hourly Windows resets. (2) Zero-Crash Universal Key Remapper: Full support for Delete and media keys with bulletproof null-safe event delegates. (3) Avatar Cropper Upgrade: 0.1x - 4.0x zoom range auto-fitting high-res gamer avatars with zero stuck dragging. (4) ExitLag-Style Auto-Ping DNS: Measures live ping latency on tab open with 1-click lowest-latency routing. (5) Esports Mic Isolation & De-Bleed: Disables Stereo Mix loopback, strips +30dB AGC noise boost, and locks clean source audio. (6) Discord Rich Presence Toggle: User preference toggle in Settings. (7) Compact Random Hub: Refined, sleek sub-tab cards.
